search_text: published ZDI-23-678 ZDI-CAN-19280 Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation Directory Traversal Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-17 CVE-2023-1134 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-1134 7.1 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H ['Delta Electronics'] ['InfraSuite Device Master'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of an administrator. Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation Directory Traversal Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the CtrlLayerNWCmd_ReportFileOperation function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of an administrator.
